description.value: Togo Sushi is a takeout-focused sushi chain with a location at UBC Vancouver on Shrum Lane, well-positioned for cyclists riding the popular paths through the UBC campus and Pacific Spirit Park. The brand is built around grab-and-go ordering, with online and app-based ordering available. As one of several Lower Mainland locations, it offers a familiar, quick-service option for cyclists needing a fast, filling meal.
